title: Small-Business Valuation review
caseBoundary: Owns estimating a business value at a stated date and transaction perimeter, not calculating required equity returns or deciding whether an expansion project should proceed.

title: Business Expansion review
caseBoundary: Owns a specific added-location or capacity investment decision, not a generic growth-strategy list, business valuation or the accounting treatment of startup costs.

title: Customer Acquisition Cost review
caseBoundary: Owns acquisition-cost boundaries, new-customer cohorts, channels and recovery, not ROAS, recruiting cost per hire or a complete lifetime-value forecast.

title: Gross Profit and Gross Margin review
caseBoundary: Owns the net-revenue-to-COGS gross-profit bridge, not the margin-versus-markup interactive calculator, net-revenue deductions or final net-income calculation.

title: Differential Cost review
caseBoundary: Owns the alternative-by-alternative relevant-cost framework, not a second make-or-buy guide, marginal-cost calculator or complete discounted capital-budgeting model.

title: Net Revenue review
caseBoundary: Owns gross-to-net sales deductions and the revenue-to-collection boundary, not gross profit after COGS, business net income or employee gross-to-net pay.
